name: Warden-class corvette
role: Earth's corvette: flak and anti-fighter guns. Model: Resources/ShipArt/earth_corvette (art_src/earth_corvette).

topSpeed.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): corvette 30-35 m/s

reverseSpeed.source: FS2 design appendix: capital ships have no reverse in the slice

rotationTime.source: FS2 design appendix: corvette turn 100 s (roll 70-80 s)

rotDamp.source: FS2 design appendix: corvette rot damp 1-2 s

sideDamp.source: Estimate: capital ships do not slide in FS2 (side damping is not in the appendix); set equal to the turn damping

forwardAccel.source: FS2 design appendix: corvette accel/decel 8 / 4 s

forwardDecel.source: FS2 design appendix: corvette accel/decel 8 / 4 s

afterburner.source: FS2 design appendix: capital ships have no afterburner

mass.source: Estimate (FS2 takes mass from the 3D model); only scales how hard knocks shove the ship

size.source: The model's own bounds (Resources/ShipArt/earth_corvette.ship.json), sensor boom and fins included
